results.name: Flood in Valencia Region, Spain
results.reason: On 29 October 2024 at 14:30 UTC, an extraordinary rainfall event affected the Valencia region. High water levels in rivers caused flooding in Ribera Alta, Horta, La Plana de Utiel and Letur river. On 31 October 2024, extraordinary precipitation caused flooding in the Castellon Province area. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide emergency mapping of flood extent, Monitoring and classification damages emergency mapping.
results.activator: Spain|Ministry of Interior - Centro Nacional de Emergencias (CENEM) de la Direccion General de Proteccion Civil y Emergencias
